description: This file defines the ContentEntityDeleteForm class, a Drupal form class for deleting content entities, including handling translations, generating confirmation questions, and logging deletion messages.

classes.name: ContentEntityDeleteForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for deleting content entities, including translation handling and confirmation prompts.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the delete confirmation form, including listing translations to be deleted.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, deleting the entity or translation and redirecting accordingly.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect to if the deletion is canceled.

methods.name: getDeletionMessage
methods.description: Generates a message indicating the deletion of a translation or entity.

methods.name: logDeletionMessage
methods.description: Logs an informational message about the deletion event.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question for deletion, customized for translations.
